title: Authorising Bench Work, Written Authorisation and Deposits
content:
# Conditions of the Work Order: Authorising Bench Work, Written Authorisation and Deposits

These conditions govern what must be agreed before the bench of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service begins work on your piece.

1. No bench work begins above the level's authorisation threshold until you have authorised it. The condition that the authorisation names a ceiling the bench may not pass is **no longer in force**; what the ceiling comes to is settled on the current basis for the ceiling agreed for work already at the bench.

2. Bench labour is charged, and the piece worked on, only while the work order stands in the workshop or has come back to the workshop under the guarantee. The state the order stands at is read from the work order record before labour or parts are priced to it, correlated by the work order reference.

3. Above the level's written authorisation threshold the authorisation is taken in writing on the workshop service request record, and a verbal agreement over the telephone does not stand in for it. What is looked at, before the work is authorised, is the amount standing on the workshop desk's request record for that work order and where that request stands.

4. Where the bench finds during the work that the ceiling will be passed, it stops and a fresh authorisation is taken for the higher figure; it never works past the ceiling and bills the difference afterwards.

5. A deposit is taken before work starts at the levels that require one, calculated as the level's share of the authorised total, and it is credited against the final balance. A deposit is taken only where the authorised total stands above the level's deposit threshold; at or below that threshold the deposit due is nothing. Where it is taken, the deposit due is the authorised total taken at the level's deposit share, rounded to the nearest cent.

6. The authorisation itself is given by you on the workshop service request record, because committing to pay for work on your own property is yours alone to do.

## Worked figures on hypothetical inputs

At a level whose deposit share is 25 percent and whose deposit threshold is 750.00 USD: an authorised total of 750.00 USD does not stand above the threshold, so the deposit due is 0.00 USD; an authorised total of 2000.00 USD stands above it, so the deposit due is 500.00 USD, credited against the final balance.

## Points of judgement on the state of the order

| The records show | Bench labour may be priced to the order |
|---|---|
| The order stands in workshop | yes |
| The order has come back to the workshop under the guarantee | yes |
| The order stands at awaiting authorization | no |
| The order stands delivered | no |
